steps.instruction:
L持續增加時穩態假設失效，先查服務不足或取消未回收；不可繼續套固定平均。

Growing L invalidates steady state; check undercapacity or unreclaimed cancellations.
Against the nominal Serving boundary result, build competing physical-fault and sensing/logging-offset explanations. steps.instruction:

steps.instructionEn:
Deliver arrival/completion logs, occupancy integral, cancellation reclamation and admission policy.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for Serving boundary: Measure arrival rate and residence time within one boundary to derive average requests in system.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Measure arrival rate and residence time within one boundary to derive average requests in system. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
